heading: Architecting the Future
paragraphs: I am Shravan Kapare, a Computer Science Engineering student passionate about Artificial Intelligence, backend development, and intelligent automation.

I enjoy building software that solves practical problems using Python, Generative AI, and modern backend technologies. My interests range from LLM-powered assistants and automation systems to scalable web applications and real-world engineering solutions.
I continuously learn by building projects, participating in hackathons, and exploring emerging technologies that can create meaningful impact.
